_comment: Hand edits for ranks 5001+ of the Turkish deck (tools/extend_deck_turkish.py). Keys are lemmas. {"drop": true} removes a lemma from the extension; {"gloss": "...", "pos": "n", "posName": "noun"} replaces the automatic gloss / part of speech (and bypasses the automatic gloss filters). Only the extension (ranks 5001+) is affected; the first 5,000 cards are never touched. The reviewed base-deck drops in tr.json (_drop) apply as well.
